title: Quorum Delegate Blocked Question
description: Documentary reference for the rich BLOCKED question payload a delegate emits after the 'BLOCKED:' marker (see internal/core/blocked_signal.go and docs/adr/0011). Native Go (BlockedQuestion.Validate) is the authoritative validator at runtime; this schema is not wired into runtime validation. It replaces the removed legacy single-line form (missing_file/reason/severity): an incomplete question is not a question and is reclassified as attempt/malformed_question, never blocked.

question.description: One decidable sentence the human can answer.

attempted.description: What the delegate tried or analyzed before asking.

evidence.description: At least one concrete file/line reference or excerpt grounding the question.

consequence.description: What happens if this option is chosen: cost/benefit. An option without a consequence is invalid.

options.description: At least two decidable options, each stating its consequence.

recommendation.description: Which option the delegate recommends and why. Optional but expected.

open_option.description: Always present: invites the human to answer outside the menu when none of the options fit.
